scope: tools/doc-parser image (oo-docs-parser), spec 90 §3 SBOM gate; supply-chain/policy.md §2 written review of weak-copyleft obligations
reviewer_role: engineering coordinator (Super Ontology integration thread). Not legal advice: every entry is listed for the D67 lawyer gate before any external release.

certifi.use: unmodified PyPI wheel; CA bundle data loaded at runtime by Python libraries
certifi.obligation: MPL-2.0 is file-level copyleft: distributed Covered Software files must stay available in source form under MPL-2.0 and the notice must be kept
certifi.how_met: files are shipped unmodified in their original source form (Python source and data); the licence text ships in the wheel's dist-info inside the image; the THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES entry for the image is generated from the SBOM (open item before L3 sign-off)

tqdm.use: unmodified PyPI wheel; progress helper pulled in by Docling dependencies
tqdm.obligation: same as certifi for the MPL-2.0 files; MIT notice for the rest
tqdm.how_met: unmodified Python source shipped as-is with its licence files; THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES entry pending (open item before L3 sign-off)

glibc (vendored by auditwheel).use: dynamic loader vendored by auditwheel inside a manylinux wheel; loaded as a shared object, not statically linked into our code
glibc (vendored by auditwheel).obligation: LGPL: allow the user to replace or relink the library, provide or offer the corresponding source, keep the notice
glibc (vendored by auditwheel).how_met: shared object, replaceable in the image; corresponding source is the upstream glibc release named by the wheel build, to be recorded with a written source offer in the image THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES (open item before L3 sign-off)

libgfortran (GCC Fortran runtime).use: runtime library bundled in numpy/scipy wheels, dynamically linked
libgfortran (GCC Fortran runtime).obligation: the GCC Runtime Library Exception permits distributing the runtime with independent modules compiled by an eligible GCC compilation process without GPL obligations on those modules; keep the notice
libgfortran (GCC Fortran runtime).how_met: unmodified runtime from upstream wheels; notice to be kept in the image THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES (open item before L3 sign-off)

libgomp (GCC OpenMP runtime).use: OpenMP runtime bundled in torch/numpy wheels, dynamically linked
libgomp (GCC OpenMP runtime).obligation: as for libgfortran (GCC Runtime Library Exception)
libgomp (GCC OpenMP runtime).how_met: unmodified runtime from upstream wheels; notice to be kept in the image THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES (open item before L3 sign-off)
